summary: Verified AMYA pre-launch bug-fix round. Backend GET /api/products/cashew-brittle returns exactly two pack_sizes: [{label:'500 g', price:500, note:'10 pieces'}, {label:'1 kg', price:900, note:'20 pieces'}] — no 250g/₹300 anywhere. Frontend verified at viewports 375, 390, 430 (mobile), and 1920 (desktop): document.scrollWidth == clientWidth at every width => NO horizontal overflow. Homepage 'Our Collection' grid class = 'grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 ...' (single-column mobile, two-column >=640px). Homepage Cashew Brittle price label shows 'From ₹500' and the only ₹-price rendered on the homepage is ₹500. Homepage body contains no occurrences of '250' or '₹300'. CTA buttons collection-cta-cashew-brittle and collection-cta-oils are visible and not clipped at 390px. collection-video-call remains a wa.me link to 919675334567 (no video thumbnail/placeholder). On /product/cashew-brittle: pack-0 renders '500 g · ₹500 · 10 pieces' and is default-selected (class contains bg-terracotta); pack-1 renders '1 kg · ₹900 · 20 pieces'; pack-2 does not exist. PD prices on page: only ₹500 and ₹900. pd-whatsapp-enquiry default href points to wa.me/919675334567 with decoded message containing 'Cashew Brittle — 500 g (₹500) × 1'. After clicking pack-1, decoded message contains '1 kg (₹900)'. Product images use object-contain (verified in Home.jsx CollectionCard and ProductDetail.jsx gallery). All spec items from the review request pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: pd-whatsapp-enquiry data-testid is reused for both Order and Enquire states (label swaps via buyable flag). Not a bug but a slightly misleading id when product is 'available'.
Minor: on narrow viewports (<=390px) the pack-size button inner text wraps acceptably but px-5 py-3 could feel cramped if labels grow — current labels fit fine.
No regressions detected relative to iteration_3.
test_credentials: No auth required for these flows. Admin creds unchanged in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 4 pre-launch mobile/pack fixes fully verified. Pack sizes are strictly 500g/1kg. WhatsApp number 919675334567 used throughout. All critical data-testids present: collection-card-cashew-brittle, collection-cta-cashew-brittle, collection-cta-oils, collection-video-call, pack-0, pack-1, pd-whatsapp-enquiry.
